description: Side-by-side comparison of TRMT6 and TRMT61A contacts along the tRNA, with interface areas
code:
import requests, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs('/tmp/pdb',exist_ok=True); pd.set_option('display.width',300); pd.set_option('display.max_rows',900)
def dl(p):
    f=f"/tmp/pdb/{p}_asm1.cif"
    if not os.path.exists(f): open(f,"wb").write(requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}-assembly1.cif",timeout=180).content)
    return f
def parse(path):
    lines=open(path).read().splitlines();cols=[];rows=[];i=0
    while i<len(lines):
        if lines[i].startswith('loop_'):
            j=i+1;tmp=[]
            while j<len(lines) and lines[j].strip().startswith('_'): tmp.append(lines[j].strip());j+=1
            if tmp and tmp[0].startswith('_atom_site.'):
                cols=[t.split('.')[1] for t in tmp];k=j
                while k<len(lines) and not lines[k].startswith('#') and not lines[k].startswith('loop_'):
                    s=lines[k].strip()
                    if s: rows.append(s.split())
                    k+=1
                break
        i+=1
    d=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=cols)
    for c in ['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']: d[c]=pd.to_numeric(d[c],errors='coerce')
    d['auth_seq_id']=pd.to_numeric(d['auth_seq_id'],errors='coerce')
    return d[(d.type_symbol!='H')&(d.label_comp_id!='HOH')].reset_index(drop=True)
def elem(n):
    n=int(n)
    if n==0: return "5' G0"
    if 1<=n<=7: return "acceptor stem"
    if n in (8,9): return "8/9 hinge"
    if 10<=n<=13 or 22<=n<=25: return "D-stem"
    if 14<=n<=21: return "D-loop"
    if n==26: return "hinge 26"
    if 27<=n<=31 or 39<=n<=43: return "AC stem"
    if 32<=n<=38: return "anticodon loop"
    if 44<=n<=48: return "variable loop"
    if 49<=n<=53 or 61<=n<=65: return "T-stem"
    if 54<=n<=60: return "T-loop"
    if 66<=n<=72: return "acceptor stem"
    if 73<=n<=76: return "3' CCA end"
    return "?"
ORDER=["acceptor stem","8/9 hinge","D-stem","D-loop","hinge 26","AC stem","anticodon loop","variable loop","T-stem","T-loop","3' CCA end","5' G0"]
pid="5CCB"; d=parse(dl(pid))
# cognate pairing in 5CCB: tRNA C is bound by TRMT6 B and methylated by TRMT61A A-2
prot={'TRMT6 (chain B)':'B','TRMT61A (chain A-2, catalytic, trans)':'A-2'}
res={}
for lab,ch in prot.items():
    P=d[d.label_asym_id==ch].reset_index(drop=True); Q=d[d.label_asym_id=='C'].reset_index(drop=True)
    kp=cKDTree(P[['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']].values); kq=cKDTree(Q[['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']].values)
    dm=kp.sparse_distance_matrix(kq,4.0).tocoo()
    rows=[(int(P.auth_seq_id[i]),int(Q.auth_seq_id[j]),v) for i,j,v in zip(dm.row,dm.col,dm.data)]
    t=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['rprot','rna','d']); t['el']=t.rna.map(elem)
    res[lab]=t
    print(f"\n{lab}: {t.rprot.nunique()} protein residues contact {t.rna.nunique()} tRNA nucleotides")
    print("   nucleotides:", ",".join(str(x) for x in sorted(t.rna.unique())))
    print("   by element :", t.groupby('el').rna.nunique().reindex(ORDER).dropna().astype(int).to_dict())

# number of atom-atom contacts per tRNA nucleotide, per subunit
cnt=pd.DataFrame({lab:res[lab].groupby('rna').size() for lab in res}).fillna(0)
cnt=cnt.reindex(range(0,77)).fillna(0)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7.5),height_ratios=[2,1])
ax=axes[0]
w=0.42; x=np.arange(77)
ax.bar(x-w/2, cnt.iloc[:,0], w, label='TRMT6 (non-catalytic subunit)', color='#2f6f9f')
ax.bar(x+w/2, cnt.iloc[:,1], w, label='TRMT61A (catalytic subunit, in trans)', color='#c0523f')
for a,b,c in [(1,7,'acceptor'),(10,25,'D-arm'),(27,43,'anticodon arm'),(44,48,'variable'),(49,65,'T-arm')]:
    ax.axvspan(a-0.5,b+0.5,color='k',alpha=0.04)
    ax.text((a+b)/2, ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.0+46, c, ha='center', fontsize=8, color='0.3')
ax.axvline(58, color='#8a2f8a', lw=1.2, ls='--'); ax.text(58,49,'A58',ha='center',color='#8a2f8a',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('tRNA3Lys nucleotide (Sprinzl numbering, 5CCB chain C)')
ax.set_ylabel('atom-atom contacts < 4 A')
ax.set_title('Which subunit touches which part of the tRNA (5CCB, substrate complex)')
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9); ax.set_xlim(-1,77); ax.set_ylim(0,52)

ax=axes[1]
lab=['TRMT6 :\ncognate tRNA','TRMT61A :\nsame tRNA','TRMT6 : TRMT61A\n(cis)','TRMT6 : TRMT61A\n(trans)','TRMT6 :\nsecond tRNA']
val=[1701,1440,2493,1462,221]
cols=['#2f6f9f','#c0523f','#6a8f3a','#8a8f3a','#9fb6c9']
b=ax.barh(lab[::-1], val[::-1], color=cols[::-1])
for r,v in zip(b,val[::-1]): ax.text(v+30, r.get_y()+r.get_height()/2, f"{v:.0f}", va='center', fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('buried surface area per side (A$^2$), Shrake-Rupley probe 1.4 A')
ax.set_title('Interface sizes in the 5CCB tetramer')
ax.set_xlim(0,2900)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
